data.title: 厄普西隆 · 哥特尖塔之巅的月夜罗网
data.description: 巨大血色圆月悬挂在王都哥特钟塔后方。厄普西隆卓立在滴水兽雕像上，十指弹动布下漫天交错的深紫魔力斩击丝线，目光睥睨冷酷。
data.location: gothic cathedral gargoyle spire overlooking a sprawling moonlit fantasy city
data.action: perched atop a carved stone gargoyle high above capital, manipulating glowing purple magic threads spreading across sky, haughty lethal smile
data.lighting: 巨月冷辉与魔力丝线紫芒
data.promptProse: Epsilon balances effortlessly on a gothic gargoyle under a massive full moon, weaving glowing purple slime threads into a deadly aerial net with a haughty smile.
data.animaCaption: Phosphorescent purple threads crisscross the moonlight behind her poised silhouette. Moonlight and the glowing threads illuminate her face, the spire and the city behind her.
